newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks soar at close on Hub Power, PTCL.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks soar at close on Hub Power, PTCL.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared at the close on Monday after a weak open, on buying of Hub Power and telecom utility PTCL shares, dealers said.

They said index could gain further today in the computerised trading session. "Hub Power's sharp rise has been quite amazing," dealer Sameer Ahmed said. "Although there is no particular news relating to the stock as such, but it is generally considered the strongest stock." "The GDR (Global Depository Receipt) rates of Hub Power have gone up and there had been both foreign and local buying in Hub Power and PTCL."

He said sentiment was likely to remain positive in the short term, but from current levels there could be a technical correction. The index rose 24.71 points, or 1.48 percent, to end at 1,698.76. Losers beat gainers 152 to 102. The index has gained 108.32 points in the last four straight sessions. Hub Power rose 2.15 rupees to 47.50 and PTCL 0.65 to 34.75.
